<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-71" status="unreviewed"> de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re rtags la chos kyis ma khyab na ni yang dag rtags su 'gal la khyab na ni khyab byed kho na la yod pas yod pa chos can ma yin pa nyams la | tshogs don la sgrub bya'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> med na ni sgrub byar 'gal
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="53b4"/>la yod na ni <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> kyi yod pa chos can yin pas yod sa chos can ma yin pa nyaMs so zhes zer ba ma yin te | sgrub bya'i chos de phyogs chos kyi yod sa chos can ma yin pa dang rjes 'gro'i khyab pa yod da chos can yin pa mi 'gal la | tshogs don yang sgrub bya'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> kyi yod sa chos can yin pa dang phyogs chos kyi yod sa chos can ma yin pa
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="53b5"/>mi 'gal lo ||</seg></TEI>
